name: Bentonville
summary: Walmart's hometown, transformed by its fortune into a world-class American art museum and a mountain-biking mecca — the last stop before Texas.

lodging.name: A hotel near the Bentonville square
lodging.blurb: Walkable to Crystal Bridges and the trails.

foodMustTry.name: An Ozark farm-to-table dinner
foodMustTry.blurb: Bentonville's food scene has boomed with the museum crowd.

days.label: Day 314 — Crystal Bridges
days.summary: World-class American art in the Ozarks.

item.title: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art

location.name: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art

item.blurb: Alice Walton's spectacular (free) museum of American art in a Moshe Safdie building over a spring-fed ravine — Gilbert Stuart to Warhol.

item.title: The Walmart Museum & the square
item.blurb: Sam Walton's original five-and-dime on the town square, plus the region's celebrated mountain-bike trails.

days.label: Day 315 — Into Oklahoma
days.summary: West to Tulsa — the Deep South is done.

commute.scenicNote: West into Oklahoma as the trip turns toward Texas and the Plains.
